Action Description: Build and install the app pointing at the staging server (search feature flag on). Go to **Add Project**. Type a public project name and wait for the results list. Verify each public hit renders its own logo, and confirm in the network inspector that no per-hit logo URL request is fired.
Expected: Each public project hit shows its logo (not the generic placeholder). No extra network request per result; logo appears synchronously with the list.

Action Description: Go to **Add Project** and search for a private project. Verify the locked placeholder is displayed for the private hit.
Expected: Private hits show `ec5-locked.png`. No network call for a private logo, no broken image.

Action Description: Point the app at a staging server with the search feature flag disabled. Search for a public project. Verify the project appears with its logo.
Expected: Public project still appears with its logo, constructed client-side from the slug (legacy behavior preserved).

Action Description: With the feature flag on, search for a public project whose payload contains `logo_base64: null` (or empty string). Verify the generic placeholder is rendered for that hit.
Expected: Public hit shows the generic placeholder (`ec5-placeholder-100x100.jpg`), not a broken-image icon.

Action Description: From **Add Project**, tap a previously displayed public project. Wait for the project to load. Verify the project opens with the correct logo and entries load normally.
Expected: The selected project opens and the logo download on the project detail/entries view works as before (this path was intentionally left unchanged).

Action Description: On the web admin, edit a form's group and add a new question into that group. Sync/download that form's project on the app (so an older entry now has a group input without an answer). Open the old entry in Entry View. Verify the entry renders, the new group question is skipped, and there is no crash.
Expected: Entry view renders without error; the new group question is skipped (not rendered as blank/broken). No Rollbar error (Cannot read properties of undefined).

Action Description: Create/obtain an entry containing a group
Expected: where a question was added into that group after the entry was collected. Open the entry (including via branch view if the group is nested in a branch). Verify it renders without error.
column3: The entry/branch view renders; the group question without an answer is skipped cleanly. No Rollbar error.

Action Description: Open **Entries Upload** with unsynced entries. Tap **Upload Data** and immediately tap it again (or trigger from a second UI path). Verify the button is disabled during the run and only one upload executes.
Expected: The second upload is ignored — the Upload Data button is disabled while uploading. Only one upload runs at a time; no duplicate or corrupt uploads.

Action Description: With photos, audio, and video present, start **Upload Photos**. Immediately try **Upload Audio** and **Upload Data**. Verify the buttons are disabled while photos are uploading, and enabled again when finished.
Expected: The other upload buttons are disabled until the current upload finishes; no concurrent upload sessions.

Action Description: Queue media files for upload. Remove the pending files (or simulate the queue being consumed) during the run. Verify the upload finishes without an unhandled error and the error list (if any) is shown.
Expected: Upload completes gracefully; any already-collected errors are returned; no crash, no white screen.

Action Description: Enable airplane mode (or point the app at an unreachable server). From **Add Project**, tap a project to add it. Verify the timeout/network error appears and the app returns to the search list.
Expected: Progress dialog is dismissed, a network/timeout error is shown, and the user is returned to the Add Project flow without a crash or a stuck spinner.

Action Description: Use a staging project with an empty form (zero inputs). Add it from the search. Verify the ec5_133 alert appears and the app returns to the Add Project list.
Expected: The app shows the ec5_133 alert ("no inputs"), does not add the project, and returns to the flow without a stuck progress dialog.

Action Description: Log out (or use an expired JWT). Attempt to add a project that triggers an auth error. Verify the error is displayed and the app returns to a stable screen.
Expected: The appropriate error is shown and the user is returned to the project list; no unhandled promise rejection or indefinite progress spinner.

Action Description: Run `npm run rollbar` in a release-configured environment. Verify the native production build completes first, then the Rollbar source-map upload runs.
Expected: Release build completes; `npm run rollbar` has the prerollbar prerequisite wired (no functional UI change).

Action Description: On the web admin, add a new question to an existing group in a project. On the app, open the project (do not re-select it from the project list, so the local structure remains outdated). Navigate to **Entries Download** and tap to download entries for the form containing the group. Verify the "Update form on your device?" dialog appears. Confirm the update. Verify the "Wait…" progress dialog appears while the project updates. Verify the download proceeds and the newly-added group question appears in the downloaded entries.
Expected: A confirmation dialog appears: "Update form on your device?" with the message "Form has been updated." If the user confirms, a "Wait…" progress dialog appears while the project updates. After the update completes, the download proceeds. All group questions (including newly-added ones) appear in the downloaded entries.

Action Description: Ensure the project is up to date (re-select it from the project list if needed). Navigate to **Entries Download** and tap to download entries. Verify no update dialog appears and the download starts immediately. Verify the download button is disabled while downloading.
Expected: No update dialog appears; the download starts directly. Download buttons are disabled while the download is in progress.

Action Description: On a device with an outdated project structure, navigate to **Entries Download**. Tap to download entries. When the "Update form on your device?" dialog appears, tap **No** / dismiss the dialog. Verify the download does not start and the user remains on the Entries Download page. Verify the download button is re-enabled.
Expected: The download does not start. The user stays on the Entries Download page with no error. The download button is re-enabled.

Action Description: Download entries for a form that already has remote entries on the device. Verify the previous remote entries are replaced with the newly-downloaded entries. Verify no duplicate entries appear in the entries list.
Expected: The previous remote entries are removed and replaced with the newly-downloaded entries. No duplicate entries appear.

Action Description: Start a download, then restart it to trigger the warning dialog. Verify the warning message text matches the expected replacement wording. Verify the "Learn more" button is present and opens the documentation page. Verify the dialog remains open after tapping "Learn more".
Expected: The warning dialog shows three buttons: "Learn more" (left), "Cancel" (center), and "OK" (right). The warning message reads: "This will replace any matching entries currently stored on this device for this project with their remote version. Continue?" (or equivalent in the current language). Tapping "Learn more" opens `https://docs.epicollect.net/mobile-application/download-entries` and the dialog remains open.

Action Description: Download entries from a project to the device. Verify the entries appear as synced. Trigger an unsync on the entries. Verify the remote entries still show as synced. Navigate to **Entries Upload**. Verify the upload button is disabled and the unsynced count shows 0 entries.
Expected: Remote entries remain synced after unsync. Upload button stays disabled when only remote entries exist.

Action Description: If possible, unsync a remote entry via the entries list. Navigate to **Entries Upload**. If the upload button is enabled (locally-created entries exist), tap to upload. Verify the upload completes without errors and the remote entry was not sent to the server.
Expected: Upload completes without errors. Remote entries are skipped entirely (no POST request made). Progress bar reflects only locally-created entries.

Action Description: Build and install the app (Android or iOS) pointing at the staging server. Log out if a session is already active. Open a page that requires login (e.g. Add Project, or open a private project). On the login modal, switch to passwordless login. Enter the email and submit — the send-email modal opens on top of the login modal. Enter the 6-digit code — the code-entry modal opens on top of the send-email modal (3 modals stacked). Tap **Login** and watch the modal stack close. Verify: no crash, all modals gone, toast shown, no `nextSibling` error in the console.
Expected: All three modals dismiss one after the other (topmost first). No crash, no white screen, and no `nextSibling` error in the console or Rollbar. The login success toast appears and the user lands on the page they were on.

Action Description: Log out. Open the login modal and enter a valid username and password. Submit and wait for the response. Verify the modal closes cleanly and the user is logged in.
Expected: The login modal closes, the login success toast appears, no crash and no `nextSibling` error in the console or Rollbar. If a pending project update was stored, it continues after login.

Action Description: Log out and open the login modal. Choose **Sign in with Google** (or **Apple**). Complete the provider flow in the system browser. Return to the app and verify the modals closed without error.
Expected: All open modals close, the login success toast appears, no crash and no `nextSibling` error.

Action Description: Register a new account (or re-verify an email that requires confirmation). When the confirm-email modal appears, enter the verification code and submit. Verify the modal closes cleanly and the user is logged in.
Expected: The confirm-email modal (and any stacked modals) closes, the login success toast appears, no crash and no `nextSibling` error.

Action Description: Configure the staging server with a short JWT TTL (~5 minutes). Build and install the app pointing at the staging server. Log in and open a project whose structure is outdated (so the version check triggers an update). Wait for the JWT to expire. Force the project update (re-open the project / navigate into its entries) so the update request fails with an auth error — a toast appears and the login modal opens. Dismiss the login modal (swipe down) and navigate to a page with no active project (e.g. **Add Project**). Open the login modal again and complete a passwordless login (send email + enter code). Verify: no crash, user stays on the page, toast shown, no `details` error in the console or Rollbar.
Expected: After login completes there is **no crash**, no white screen, and no Rollbar error `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'details')`. The user stays on the current page and the login success toast appears. A console warning `updateProject skipped: no active project` may be logged (expected).

Action Description: Using the same short-JWT staging setup, open a project with an outdated structure so an update is triggered. Let the JWT expire mid-update so an auth error occurs and the login modal appears. Complete the login immediately while still on the project page (do not navigate away). Verify the deferred update completes normally (progress dialog, result alert, entries loaded).
Expected: The deferred project update runs: the "Updating project…" progress dialog is shown, the update-result alert appears, and entries reload. No crash.
